class.name: OpenXRMlPlaneDetector
class.experimental: Marked as experimental due to lack of community validation on Magic Leap devices.
class.brief_description: Represents a plane detector in Magic Leap's Plane Detection API.
class.description: Represents a plane detector in Magic Leap's Plane Detection API. A plane detector detects plane types as specified by the [member settings] property. To create different flavours of plane detection, an application may create multiple plane detectors. The plane detector is only active when added to the scene tree.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Gets the status of the plane detector.

members.member: The settings of the plane detector. Changing this value or any of the properties of the detector settings will restart the plane detector.
The detection enabled flag determines whether planed detection is enabled (true) or not (false).
The contour bit determines whether contour information is returned by the detector (true) or not (false).

constants.constant: The plane detector is performing plane detection.
The plane detector has finished plane detection and is ready to be inspected.
The plane detector has encountered an error.
The plane detector has encountered a fatal error.
Maximum value for the plane detector status enum.
